Technical specifications
Type of pump | KSB ETA 80 20VL.
Manufacturer | Siemens Germany.
Type of fluid | Oil VG 46.
Shaft | Vertical.
Capacity | 1.7 M3 / 
 min.
Discharge pressure | 5 Bars.
Temperature | 55 C.
Driver | Electric motor.
Power required | 30 KW.
Speed | 2940 RPM.
Bearing type | Ball bearing [6406 C3].
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, gloves, etc.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing delivery valve.
Be sure that the pump is completely drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid,
 Filler. Rags.
Vibrometer,
 Dial indicator.
Work to be Carried Out
Measure vibration level for bearing and compare it with the setting values, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do [if it is needed].
Check discharge, pressure and compare it with the setting values then 
 replace the worn-out components [if it is needed].
Check the alignment and compare with the setting values.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tighten it [if it is needed].
Test the bearing oil, add or change oil [if it is required].
Check the leakage from the glands.
Check the leakage from the flanges.
Check the pump casing against rust and re -paint [if it is required].
